Latin word

vehemēns

vehemēns, vehementis

adjective, third declension, one ending

intense, strong, violent; vehement, impetuous, fierce

In this lexicon

  • intense

    the recommended word · classical · Plin. NH 24.62: dolor capitis vehementior (Lewis & Short); Lucr. 6.517: imber (Lewis & Short); Plin. NH 17.235: vīs frīgorum aut calōrum (Lewis & Short)

  • violent

    also used · classical · Cic. Vat. 4: vehemēns ferōxque nātūrā (Lewis & Short)
